transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. What brings you in to see me today?

Hello. Um... well, I just feel like I can't settle inside my own skin anymore. It's... I don't know. Even when I'm completely worn out and I know I should just be sitting still, I feel like I have to jump up and do the next thing. So... that's why I came in.
Do you have any thoughts that keep repeating in your mind and won't go away?
No, not really. I don't... I don't think so. Just the usual things, I guess. Nothing that gets stuck.
Do you feel anxious most of the time?
I don't... I wouldn't say I'm anxious. I just can't sit still. It's not worry, exactly. Just... restlessness, I suppose.
Do you feel like you have to do certain things over and over?
No... I don't think so. Not that I've noticed.
Do you often act on impulse without thinking things through?
Impulse? Um... no, I don't think so. I just... I mean, I just go about my day. I don't really do things like that. Not that I can think of, anyway.
Do you often find yourself talking more than others in social situations?
Talking? Um... no. I don't really think I do. I usually just... keep to myself, mostly. So, no, not really.
Do you often find yourself engaging in more activities or taking on more tasks than others?
Um... no. I don't think so. I don't really do all that much these days anyway... just my normal routine, I guess. I don't take on extra things.
Do you often fidget or feel restless when you're sitting with other people?

Well... I suppose so. I don't mean to. Just... like in church meetings, I guess. I might tap my foot a bit... or just rub the edge of my purse. I shift around in my chair sometimes. The ladies beside me usually start looking over... so, I suppose I do.
Do you often find yourself easily distracted by things around you?

Yes... I suppose I do. Like... if I'm trying to sort my bills at the kitchen table. It's just... if I hear a car door outside, or the phone lights up... or even if I just start thinking about the garden. I just... get completely pulled off track. So... yes.
Are your restlessness and difficulty sitting still interfering with your work or daily activities?

Um... yes. I suppose so. My family... well, they've actually had to step in with the bills and paperwork lately. And... at church, and the garden group... I guess people have had to cover responsibilities I dropped, or redo plans because of me. It's... well, it's rather embarrassing to admit. I just... I don't think the groups I care about feel they can count on me anymore.
When did you first start feeling this restlessness and inability to sit still?
Well... I suppose it's really been a problem for... about a year and ten months now. Since... since my husband passed away. That's when all this really started causing trouble.
Do you often have trouble following through on instructions or finishing tasks because you lose focus?

Yes... I suppose that happens. Um... like with the quilting charity. If they give me three or four things to do... I might start the first one right away. But then... well, I just sort of wander off into another chore. And... the last steps just never get done. So... yes.
Do you often interrupt others when they're talking?

I... yes. More than I mean to, I suppose. Um... especially during the committee meetings. A thought will just... pop into my head, and I end up blurting it out. Even if someone else is still talking. I just... I know it's rude, but if I don't say it right then, I'll lose it. So... yes, I do.
Do you often have difficulty sustaining focus during tasks or activities?

I... yes, I suppose. Um... like if I sit down to read the senior center newsletter. Or... maybe the choir schedule. I start out fine, but... well, after a few minutes, I'll realize my eyes have just gone over the same lines again and again. And I... I have no idea what I just read. So... yes.
Do you often make careless mistakes when doing things like chores, work tasks, or activities?

I... yes. I suppose so. Just... little mistakes, mostly. But they... well, they end up turning into big messes. 

Um... like with the garden club checkbook. I'll write down the wrong amount. Or... the church supper list. I'll leave a name off, even when I... I really thought I checked it. So... yes.
How old were you when you first started feeling this restlessness and inability to sit still?

I... well, I don't know an exact age. Just... always, I suppose. 

Um... even back in grade school. My teachers... they used to write that I was bright, but careless. I was always losing my papers, or... talking out of turn. They had to keep giving me reminders to... to stay in my seat. Or to just finish my work. So... it's been a very long time.
Did you have any problems with restlessness, fidgeting, or finishing tasks when you were a child?
I... well, I thought I just mentioned that. Um... yes. The teachers always said I was... out of my seat. And not finishing my work. So... yes, it was a problem back then, too.
Have you experienced these problems with restlessness and finishing tasks in multiple areas of your life, such as at home, in social situations, and in other activities?

Yes. I... I suppose it affects everything. 

Um... at home, my family has had to... well, step in. With the bills and the paperwork. And... I mentioned the church and the garden club earlier. The people there... they've had to redo plans. Or cover responsibilities I just... dropped. 

It's... I don't really like talking about it. I feel very embarrassed. It just seems like... the groups I care about, they don't feel they can count on me anymore.
Did your restlessness and difficulty sitting still start in childhood and continue into adulthood, or did it start later in life?

I... well, I thought we just went over this. Um... yes, it started in childhood. Like I said about grade school. And... it just kept going, I suppose. It's still happening now. It didn't just start recently.
Do you often have trouble organizing your time or tasks to meet deadlines?
I... I don't really know. I'm not working anymore, so... I don't really have deadlines to meet. I haven't really thought about it.
